description: This Java class configures a Spring Batch job named 'generateAdhocClientSchedule'. It sets up the job's steps, tasklet, and dependencies for generating an ad hoc client schedule within the Fineract platform. The class primarily manages workflow wiring using Spring Batch and Spring Framework annotations.

classes.name: GenerateAdhocClientScheduleConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that defines beans for a Spring Batch job to generate ad hoc client schedules in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: generateAdhocClientScheduleStep
methods.description: Defines and returns the batch processing step which executes the tasklet for generating ad hoc client schedule.

methods.name: generateAdhocClientScheduleJob
methods.description: Defines and returns the batch job that includes the schedule step, with a unique run ID incrementer.

methods.name: generateAdhocClientScheduleTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the tasklet responsible for executing the core logic of generating the schedule.
